/can-chatgpt/open-zip-files/.intro: Sometimes. ChatGPT can unpack an uploaded zip with its code tool. A Zip server lets you look inside first and pull out one file at a time.
/can-chatgpt/open-zip-files/.without_tool: With its code tool, ChatGPT can often unpack a zip you upload and read the files inside its sandbox. It doesn't warn you about traversal paths or a suspicious compression ratio, and the files stay in that one chat.
/can-chatgpt/open-zip-files/.with_tool: The Zip server lists every entry with sizes and ratios, reads one text file without unpacking the rest, and unpacks safely with traversal, absolute-path and symlink entries refused. The hosted server can't see files on your computer. It takes a file from a public link or a small upload (up to 1 MB), and new files come back as one-hour download links. To try it in ChatGPT on the web, where your plan or workspace allows custom MCP servers, get a free token at mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect and add mcp.zovo.one/mcp/zip/t/<token> as a server with No authentication. We haven't tested this in ChatGPT yet.

example.prompt: List what's inside client-records-q3.zip, then show me notes.txt from it without unpacking the rest.

steps.does: Lists every entry with size and compression ratio
Reads notes.txt straight from the archive

example.result: A list of the archive's files and sizes, and the text of notes.txt, with nothing else unpacked.

pitfalls: Unpacking an unknown zip before you look at the list.
Ignoring a huge compression ratio, a sign of a zip bomb.
Assuming every ChatGPT plan can add a custom MCP server. Check your plan first.
/can-chatgpt/open-zip-files/.answer: ChatGPT can often unpack an uploaded zip with its code tool. The Zip server lists entries, reads one file without unpacking and refuses unsafe paths. It runs hosted or locally in Claude and Cursor.

/can-chatgpt/zip-files/.intro: Yes, for files it already has. ChatGPT's code tool can pack files you upload into a .zip. A Zip server does the same with patterns and keeps a history of what it made.
/can-chatgpt/zip-files/.without_tool: With its code tool, ChatGPT can put files you upload into a .zip and give you a download. It can't reach folders on your computer, and it keeps no record of past archives.
/can-chatgpt/zip-files/.with_tool: The Zip server packs files or a whole folder into a new .zip with glob patterns, adds files to an existing archive and lists the archives it made. Locally it reads your folders. The hosted server can't see files on your computer. It takes a file from a public link or a small upload, and the archive comes back as a one-hour download link. To try it in ChatGPT on the web, where your plan or workspace allows custom MCP servers, get a free token at mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect and add mcp.zovo.one/mcp/zip/t/<token> as a server with No authentication. We haven't tested this in ChatGPT yet.

example.prompt: Pack every .png and .pdf in the client-final folder into handoff.zip, then list what went in.

steps.does: Packs the matching files into handoff.zip
Lists the entries with their sizes

example.result: handoff.zip with only the PNG and PDF files, and a list to check before you send it.

pitfalls: Zipping a folder with hidden system files in it.
Sending an archive without checking the list first.
Expecting a hosted server to read a folder on your own disk.
/can-chatgpt/zip-files/.answer: ChatGPT's code tool can zip files you upload. The Zip server packs files with glob patterns, adds to archives and keeps a history. Locally in Claude or Cursor it reads your folders directly.

/can-chatgpt/create-xlsx-files/.intro: Yes. ChatGPT's code tool can write an .xlsx in its sandbox. A Spreadsheet server does it as a repeatable tool call and can query the file afterwards.
/can-chatgpt/create-xlsx-files/.without_tool: With its code tool, ChatGPT can build an .xlsx and give you a download link. Without it you get a table or CSV text to paste, and pasted tables often land in one column.
/can-chatgpt/create-xlsx-files/.with_tool: The Spreadsheet server writes rows to .xlsx, .csv, .tsv or .json, adds computed columns to a new file, converts formats and summarizes a column. On the hosted endpoint each file comes back as a download and stays available by name for the next call. To try it in ChatGPT on the web, where your plan or workspace allows custom MCP servers, get a free token at mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect and add mcp.zovo.one/mcp/spreadsheet/t/<token> as a server with No authentication. We haven't tested this in ChatGPT yet.

/can-chatgpt/create-xlsx-files/.answer: ChatGPT can create an .xlsx with its code tool. The Spreadsheet server writes .xlsx and .csv files as tool calls, adds columns and converts formats. It runs hosted or locally in Claude and Cursor.

/can-chatgpt/create-qr-codes/.answer: ChatGPT's image tool draws fake QR codes. Its code tool can sometimes make real ones. The Barcode server makes scannable QR, WiFi, contact and payment codes. It runs hosted or locally in Claude and Cursor.

/can-chatgpt/edit-pdfs/.intro: Partly. ChatGPT can rework a PDF you upload with its code tool. A PDF server handles page work like merge, split, rotate and stamp. Neither rewrites the original text in place.
/can-chatgpt/edit-pdfs/.without_tool: With its code tool, ChatGPT can often merge, split or rotate an uploaded PDF and give you a new file. Changing the words inside a PDF usually means rebuilding the document, and the layout can shift.
/can-chatgpt/edit-pdfs/.with_tool: The PDF server merges, splits, pulls out pages, reorders, rotates, stamps a word such as PAID, and adds your business name to every footer. It doesn't edit the existing text and doesn't fill forms. The hosted server can't see files on your computer. It takes a file from a public link or a small upload (up to 2 MB), and each new PDF comes back as a download link. To try it in ChatGPT on the web, where your plan or workspace allows custom MCP servers, get a free token at mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect and add mcp.zovo.one/mcp/pdf/t/<token> as a server with No authentication. We haven't tested this in ChatGPT yet.

Uploading client PDFs to free online editors.
/can-chatgpt/edit-pdfs/.answer: ChatGPT can rework an uploaded PDF with its code tool. The PDF server merges, splits, rotates, reorders and stamps PDFs as new files. It doesn't edit text or fill forms.

/can-chatgpt/open-pdfs/.intro: Yes. You can upload a PDF to ChatGPT and ask about it. A PDF server helps when you need page counts, exact page ranges or a new file out of it.
/can-chatgpt/open-pdfs/.without_tool: ChatGPT reads a PDF you upload and can answer questions about it. Scanned pages need it to read the image. Splitting or counting pages across many files needs its code tool.
/can-chatgpt/open-pdfs/.with_tool: The PDF server reports page count, paper size and metadata, extracts text from standard-font PDFs (no OCR for scans), counts pages across many files and writes new PDFs from page ranges. The hosted server can't see files on your computer. It takes a file from a public link or a small upload (up to 2 MB). /can-chatgpt/open-pdfs/.answer: ChatGPT can open a PDF you upload and answer questions about it. The PDF server adds page counts, text extraction from standard PDFs and new files from page ranges.

/can-chatgpt/know-the-time/.with_tool: The Timezone server gives the current time in one or more places, converts a time between zones with day changes marked, lists daylight saving changes and finds meeting slots inside everyone's working hours. /can-chatgpt/do-my-taxes/.intro: No. ChatGPT can't file a return. It can explain rules and do math. The Tax Calculator server gives a quick US federal estimate for a single filer, and nothing more.
/can-chatgpt/do-my-taxes/.without_tool: ChatGPT can explain tax terms and walk through a calculation, but it can't file for you and can get bracket numbers wrong. Treat any figure it gives as a draft to check.
/can-chatgpt/do-my-taxes/.with_tool: The Tax Calculator server has one tool. It takes gross income, subtracts the $15,750 standard deduction, which is the 2025 tax-year figure, applies the single-filer federal brackets and returns taxable income, federal tax, effective rate and after-tax income. No state tax, credits or other filing status. It runs locally in Claude Desktop or Cursor and isn't hosted, so it doesn't work in ChatGPT.

pitfalls: Filing from a chat answer.

/can-chatgpt/do-my-taxes/.answer: No. ChatGPT can't file taxes. The Tax Calculator server gives a US federal estimate for a single filer. It runs locally in Claude Desktop or Cursor, not ChatGPT. Use tax software or a preparer to file.

/can-cursor/read-excel-files/.intro: Not directly. Cursor reads text files, and .xlsx is a binary format. Its agent can write a script to parse one, or a Spreadsheet server reads it in one call.
/can-cursor/read-excel-files/.without_tool: Cursor's file reader can't parse an .xlsx. The agent can write and run a Python or Node script in the terminal, which depends on the libraries you have installed.
/can-cursor/read-excel-files/.with_tool: The Spreadsheet server reads .xlsx and .csv by path, shows sheets and columns, filters rows, searches every cell and summarizes columns. It runs over stdio in Cursor and writes changes to a new file.

example.prompt: Show the sheets and columns in data/customers.xlsx, then list rows where country is DE.

steps.does: Lists sheets, columns and row counts
Filters rows where country is DE

example.result: The workbook layout and the matching rows, without writing a parsing script.

pitfalls: Committing a one-off parsing script to the repo.
Reading only the first sheet of a workbook.
Dates coming back as serial numbers.
/can-cursor/read-excel-files/.answer: Cursor can't read .xlsx with its file reader. Its agent can write a parsing script. The Spreadsheet server reads, filters and summarizes Excel files by path in one call.

/can-cursor/edit-word-documents/.intro: Not directly. A .docx is a zipped XML package, and Cursor edits text files. A DOCX server reads the document and writes a new one for you.
/can-cursor/edit-word-documents/.without_tool: Cursor can't open a .docx in its editor as text. The agent can unzip and patch the XML with a script, which breaks formatting easily.
/can-cursor/edit-word-documents/.with_tool: The DOCX server reads the text and heading outline of a .docx, fills {{placeholders}} in a template, writes a .docx from markdown and converts a .docx to HTML. It runs over stdio in Cursor and writes a new file each time.

example.prompt: Fill release-template.docx with version 2.4.0 and today's date, and save it as release-2.4.0.docx.

steps.does: Replaces each placeholder and reports any it couldn't fill

example.result: release-2.4.0.docx in the original layout, with every placeholder filled.

pitfalls: Editing document.xml by hand and corrupting the file.
Placeholders split across two text runs by Word.
Overwriting the template instead of writing a new file.
/can-cursor/edit-word-documents/.answer: Cursor can't edit a .docx as text. The DOCX server reads Word files, fills templates and writes new .docx files from markdown inside Cursor.

/can-cursor/read-pdf/.intro: Not reliably on its own. Cursor's file reader is made for text and code. A PDF server gives it page counts, text and new files from page ranges.
/can-cursor/read-pdf/.without_tool: Cursor's agent can try a terminal command or script to pull text out of a PDF, which depends on what you have installed. Its editor doesn't read PDF text.
/can-cursor/read-pdf/.with_tool: The PDF server reports page count, sizes and metadata, extracts text from standard-font PDFs (no OCR for scans), and merges, splits and reorders pages into new files. It runs over stdio in Cursor.

example.prompt: Read the text of docs/api-spec.pdf and tell me how many pages it has.

steps.does: Reports page count and sizes
Extracts the text from the standard-font pages

example.result: The page count and the spec text in the chat, ready to use while you code.

pitfalls: Expecting text from a scanned PDF without OCR.
Pasting a long PDF into chat by hand.
Committing large PDFs to the repo to read them.
/can-cursor/read-pdf/.answer: Cursor's file reader is made for text. The PDF server reads page counts and text from standard PDFs and writes new files from page ranges inside Cursor.

chatgpt_facts.claim: As of Nov 2026, ChatGPT can add a custom MCP server only by URL, on the web, through developer mode, and only where the plan or workspace allows it. Supported transports are SSE and streaming HTTP. Auth options are OAuth or No authentication, with no custom header, so our path-token URL mcp.zovo.one/mcp/<id>/t/<token> is the form that fits. A local or private server needs OpenAI's Secure MCP Tunnel or an HTTPS tunnel; plain local stdio is not supported. Tools without readOnlyHint are treated as write actions and need confirmation. Plan list is inconsistent across sources (OpenAI dev docs listed Pro, Plus, Business, Enterprise, Edu; help center says full write support is beta on Business, Enterprise, Edu), so pages say 'where your plan or workspace allows' and 'we haven't tested this in ChatGPT'. ChatGPT also has OpenAI-built Outlook Email and Outlook Calendar apps; calendar data is read-only and some actions need Microsoft admin approval.
notes: developer-mode and help 12584461 pages were seen only as search snippets (404/403 on fetch); custom-mcp-server.md and connect-chatgpt were fetched directly.
